name: Liver Stuffing

ingredients.name: high quality sandwich bread, cut into 3/4-inch dice, about 8 cups

instructions.primary_message: Adjust oven racks to lower-middle and upper-middle position. Preheat oven to 150°C (300°F). Spread bread evenly over 2 rimmed baking sheets. Bake until bread cubes are completely dried, 30 to 40 minutes, rotating trays and stirring bread cubes several times during baking. Remove from oven and allow to cool. Increase oven heat to 190°C (375°F).

Melt 4 tablespoons butter in a large skillet or sauté pan over medium-high heat. Add diced onions and celery and sauté over medium heat until softened but not browned, about 5 minutes. Remove and set aside.

Pat livers dry with a paper towel and cut into 5-cm segments. Melt 2 tablespoons butter in the pan over high heat. Add livers and cook until well browned on one side, about 2 minutes. Flip and continue cooking until centers are medium-rare, about 1 minute longer. Remove livers and add 1 cup of stock to pan. Remove from heat.
In a blender, food processor, or with an immersion blender, purée livers with the deglazing liquid until mixture is mostly smooth with a few small chunks of liver remaining. Set aside.
Whisk remaining stock, eggs, and dried herbs in large bowl until homogeneous. Whisk in liver mixture. Add 1/2 teaspoon salt and 1/2 teaspoon pepper. Fold in bread cubes, onions, and celery.

Use part of stuffing to stuff bird if desired. To cook remaining stuffing, transfer to a buttered 23-cm square baking dish, cover tightly with aluminum foil, and bake until an instant-read thermometer reads 66°C (150°F) when inserted into center of dish, about 45 minutes. Remove foil and continue baking until golden brown and crisp on top, about 10 minutes longer. Remove from oven, let cool for 5 minutes, sprinkle with parsley, and serve.

schema_metadata.keywords: liver, liver stuffing, stuffing, thanksgiving, The Nasty Bits

description: Classic Thanksgiving stuffing augmented with chicken livers.
notes:
Optional substitutions: high quality sandwich bread → soft Italian bread or French bread; low-sodium chicken stock → turkey stock

Notes: This recipe can be doubled easily. To double, bake the stuffing in a 9- by 33-cm baking dish.
author: Chichi Wang
